summary: Configurable PR review response scope (all|bot-only|human-only) so babysit treats Copilot and human threads as actionable by default, with suggestion metadata and high-risk path guards (#496).
migration_impact: Default pr_review_scope is all: more review threads may appear actionable than the old bot-only filter. Set autonomy.pr_review_scope to bot-only for conservative behavior. New CLI --scope and MCP scope parameters available.
migration_guidance: 1. Optionally set autonomy.pr_review_scope in .plate (all|bot-only|human-only); default all.
2. Prefer gh plate pr babysit --scope and plate_get_actionable_review_threads with scope.
3. Apply suggestion blocks when prefer_apply_suggestion; skip high-risk paths.
4. Do not re-request Copilot review in a loop; work existing threads first.
agent_notes: Default scope=all includes Copilot. Use plate_pr_babysit / --act; resolve outdated via #605 auto-resolve. High-risk paths need need:human-review.
